property_summary: For every call where c.transfer completes (does not revert), the reference contract always returns true (succeeds) when all inner low-level calls succeed and reverts if any inner call fails; the mutant inverts the success-check causing scenarios where a failing inner call makes the mutant revert or a succeeding inner call makes it revert, so there exist inputs (a callee that reverts or one that succeeds) for which the mutant's observable outcome differs from the reference.
change_summary: Invert the success check after the external call so the function returns true only when the inner call failed, changing returned boolean logic.
